assessments.reason: The frozen 24/1141/FUL site is tied to the exact address and an explicit red proposal demise; the accepted NMA record binds Rev B drawing 255402/12 back to that permission. The red line is planning/application geometry, not legal title.

Accepted drawing 255402/12 Rev B supplies the proposal demise on a controlled 1:200 A1 site plan. DPL-Q permits explicit scale and/or dimensions sufficient to reconstruct real shape/width/depth. A later candidate may derive geometry only from the controlled drawing scale/vector/document geometry; web-map, screenshot and marketing-pixel measurement remain forbidden.

The controlled location/site drawing is tied to the real street framework and identifies Uphill Road, Marsh Lane and surrounding numbered properties, providing a real placement frame rather than the synthetic Reference-Site frame.

Drawing 255402/12 Rev B identifies a proposed datum and explicit existing/proposed/pavement levels: 21.10, 20.93 and 20.23 respectively. This is sufficient to author a SCREENING house-ground relation without inventing a datum.

The controlled site plan identifies Uphill Road and the new crossover/access drive, states a maximum 1:10 drive gradient and ties the access to the proposal demise. This proves SCREENING placement/access geometry; legal access rights remain separately unresolved.

Address, permission reference, accepted NMA drawing substitution and proposal demise all identify one coherent historical site snapshot. Later 2026 applications are explicitly excluded rather than blended into the control authority.
